1231 Comstock Prime Data Center

2 Documents in Project

Summary

SCH Number
2024070671
Lead Agency
City of San Jose
Document Title
1231 Comstock Prime Data Center
Document Type
MND - Mitigated Negative Declaration
Received
7/17/2024
Present Land Use
Light Industrial uses (LO-RD under the zoning code update)
Document Description
A four-story, approximately 109,520 square-foot data center would replace the existing single-story building and the associated parking on the site. The data center would be approximately 80 feet in height and would house computer servers and supporting equipment for private clients.
